name: blacksite-vscode
description: AI coding assistant with deep workspace integration
author: Morgan Griffith

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Blacksite reads, edits, and can execute code from the workspace. Trust the workspace before enabling agent tools.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Blacksite requires a local filesystem workspace for its agent runtime, map, runs, and durable state.

commands.title: Approve External Application for Read-Only Capture
Move Chat to the Right Side Bar

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter (access many models via one key)
blacksite.provider.description: AI provider for chat. Can also be set in the sidepanel Settings.

enumDescriptions: Converse API — live model listing, dated inference-profile IDs
Messages (Mantle) API — Anthropic-native endpoint, supports Opus 4.7/4.8 and Fable 5
blacksite.bedrockApi.description: Bedrock API path. 'mantle' enables the Messages endpoint required for the latest Claude models not yet on Converse. Can also be toggled in the sidepanel Settings.

blacksite.workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root for local runtime (defaults to first workspace folder)

blacksite.permissions.allowedCommands.markdownDescription: Extra terminal binaries the agent may run, added to the built-in allowlist (for example `docker-compose`). Compared by command name, case-insensitive.

blacksite.permissions.deniedCommands.markdownDescription: Terminal binaries the agent may never run. A deny entry overrides the allowlist and auto-approve (for example `curl`, `ssh`).

blacksite.permissions.autoApprove.markdownDescription: Terminal binaries whose network/destructive operations run without an approval prompt. Populated by choosing "Always allow" on an approval, or edit manually (for example `git`, `npm`).

blacksite.permissions.allowEvalFlags.markdownDescription: ⚠️ Advanced & unsafe. Permit inline-eval arguments (`node -e`, `python -c`, `ruby -e`, …) that are blocked by default. Enabling this lets the agent execute arbitrary code passed directly on the command line.

blacksite.tickets.agentMayClose.description: Allow the agent to move tickets to Done itself. Off by default: the agent files, updates, comments, and moves work to Review, but closing stays your call — the same posture plans take toward archiving.

blacksite.tickets.idPrefix.description: Prefix for ticket ids (e.g. BLK-12). Ticket ids leak into commit messages and branch names, so a project-specific prefix is often worth setting. Changing it does not renumber existing tickets.

blacksite.graph.traceFadeSeconds.description: How long (seconds) agent activity traces on the Codebase Map take to fully fade.

blacksite.runs.temporaryRetentionDays.description: Days to retain temporary Execution Runs unless pinned.

blacksite.runs.standardRetentionDays.description: Days to retain standard Execution Runs unless pinned.

blacksite.runs.maxRuns.description: Maximum unpinned Execution Runs retained per workspace.

blacksite.runs.video.enabled.description: Allow the agent to explicitly record local browser video evidence. Recordings never start implicitly.

blacksite.runs.video.maxDiskMb.description: Maximum workspace disk budget for unpreserved browser recordings. Extracted keyframes do not count against this video budget.

blacksite.runs.video.degradeAfterDays.description: Days before unpreserved browser recordings are reduced in frame rate and resolution when ffmpeg is available.

blacksite.runs.video.deleteAfterDays.description: Days before unpreserved browser recordings are deleted. Extracted and user-flagged keyframes remain.

blacksite.runs.video.keyframeIntervalMs.description: Interval between retained adjacent keyframes sampled while browser video is recorded.

blacksite.graph.maxNodes.description: Legacy compatibility cap for files rendered on the Codebase Map. Use performanceProfile and advanced caps for larger workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Very high caps for large machines and large workspaces.

blacksite.graph.maxIndexedFiles.description: Advanced: maximum files scanned for Map indexing and service relationship detection. 0 uses the selected performance profile.

blacksite.graph.maxRenderedStars.description: Advanced: maximum file/service stars rendered in the Map. 0 uses the selected performance profile or legacy maxNodes.

blacksite.graph.maxRelationshipEdges.description: Advanced: maximum service/API relationship edges sent to the Map. 0 uses the selected performance profile.

blacksite.graph.traceShellEvents.description: Show shell/terminal activity (working-directory pulses) on the Codebase Map trace layer.

enumDescriptions: Separate distinct codebases into neighborhood territories only for large or multi-codebase workspaces.
Always separate distinct codebases into neighborhood territories.
Keep a single flat layout; do not separate codebases into territories.
blacksite.graph.neighborhoods.description: Whether the Codebase Map separates distinct codebases (projects/solutions) into their own neighborhood territories, each subdivided by purpose folders.

blacksite.graph.backgroundSymbols.description: Advanced: background-index call/reference/inheritance relationships across the whole codebase using installed language servers. Higher cost — runs on an idle budget and pauses while you edit. Off by default.

blacksite.data.previewPageSize.description: Number of rows per page in the Data workbench table preview.

blacksite.data.maxQueryRows.description: Maximum rows returned by a read query in the Data workbench Query tab.

blacksite.data.enableAssistant.description: Enable the natural-language database assistant in the Data workbench.

enumDescriptions: Embedded exact vector search persisted in SQLite (default, zero dependencies)
Optional local PostgreSQL + pgvector sidecar for higher-scale retrieval
blacksite.data.backendMode.description: Vector backend for the Data workbench.

blacksite.browserHeadless.description: Run the agent's browser window in headless mode (no visible window). Default is headed so you can watch what the agent does.

blacksite.updates.checkOnStartup.description: Check for newer Blacksite VS Code extension releases on startup, and every three hours while the window stays open. This does not use the VS Code Marketplace, and needs no credentials.

blacksite.updates.includePrerelease.description: Allow prerelease builds when checking for VS Code extension updates. Prereleases are only listed by the GitHub releases API, so enabling this bypasses the faster release manifest.

blacksite.updates.manifestUrl.description: Release manifest checked first for VS Code extension self-updates. One static request instead of the GitHub API's unauthenticated rate limit. Falls back to GitHub releases if unreachable.

blacksite.updates.repository.description: GitHub owner/repo used as the fallback source for VS Code extension self-updates (for example RoofTopDude/blacksite-vscode). Leave blank to use the repository declared in the extension package.

blacksite.integrations.gitlabHost.description: Trusted HTTPS origin that may receive the stored GitLab token. The agent cannot override this destination.

blacksite.integrations.jiraHost.description: Trusted HTTPS Jira origin that may receive the stored Jira credentials, for example https://example.atlassian.net. Required before Jira tools are exposed to the agent.

blacksite.integrations.confluenceHost.description: Trusted HTTPS Confluence origin that may receive the stored Confluence credentials. Required before Confluence tools are exposed to the agent.

blacksite.integrations.salesforceInstanc.description: Trusted HTTPS Salesforce instance origin that may receive the stored access token. Required before Salesforce tools are exposed to the agent.

blacksite.mcpServers.description: MCP server list (managed via Blacksite: Manage MCP Servers)

blacksite.planContinuation.enabled.markdownDescription: Automatically continue an approved plan when a turn ends without finishing it. A separate agent — holding your original prompts verbatim — decides whether to continue, escalate, or halt, and writes the message that continues it. **Off by default: this spends model calls and agent turns with nobody watching.**

blacksite.planContinuation.maxConsecutiv.markdownDescription: How many times in a row the plan may be continued before stopping to check in. The counter resets whenever you send a message.

blacksite.preview.projectStylesheet.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative CSS files that question-card previews are rendered against, so a preview uses the project's own design tokens and component classes instead of hand-written CSS. Leave empty to auto-detect Blacksite preview-token outputs, fingerprinted CSS in common build asset directories, or a conventional source entry such as `src/index.css`, `src/globals.css`, or `app/globals.css`.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:host && npm run lint:webview
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:host -- --fix && npm run lint:webview -- --fix
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npx --no-install vsce package && node scripts/verify-vsix.mjs
scripts.test:lsp: npm run test:lsp:unit && npm run test:lsp:integration
scripts.security: npm run security:static && npm run security:dependencies
